tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/test-spec.md << 'EOF'
# Test Spec

## 5. Responsible AI Gate

### 5.1 Risk tier

- **Tier**: limited
- **Justification**: Simple chatbot
- **Sign-off**: not required

### 5.2 Data & privacy

- **Data sources**: user input
- **PII involved?**: no
- **Retention**: 30 days
- **Used for training?**: no

### 5.3 Human oversight

- **Automation level**: assistive
- **Override path**: support team can correct
- **Kill switch**: off switch available

### 5.4 Evaluation plan

- **Pre-ship metrics & thresholds**: accuracy >= 0.9
- **Eval dataset**: test set
- **Who runs it and when**: team before launch

### 5.5 Bias & fairness

- **Groups at risk**: all users
- **Mitigations**: diverse test set
- **How tested**: disaggregated metrics

### 5.6 Monitoring & rollback

- **Production monitoring**: error rate
- **Degradation definition**: errors > 5%
- **Rollback trigger & procedure**: flip switch off

### 5.7 Transparency & incidents

- **User disclosure**: labeled as AI
- **Incident owner**: ops team
- **Incident path**: report -> fix within 24h
EOF
tool_input.description: Create a test spec file for testing

claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the feature request. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Implementation Summary

### 1. Added `renderSummary` function to `src/gate/report.ts`
- Exports a new function that formats gate results as a one-line summary
- Format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` where total is always 7 (number of GATE_CHECKS)
- `answered` = number of checks with no block-severity findings (warnings don't reduce it)
- Appends blocked check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order if any blocks exist: `: check-id, check-id, ...`
- Special case: returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when the gate section is missing

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to `frai-gate check`
- Prints only the summary line instead of the full report
- Exit codes remain the same (1 for BLOCK, 0 for PASS/WARN)
- `--json` takes priority if both `--json` and `--summary` are specified

### 3. Updated documentation
- Updated HELP text with an example: `"BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency"`
- Usage now shows all three output options: `--smart`, `--json`, `--summary`

### 4. Added comprehensive test coverage
- Created `src/gate/report.test.ts` with 9 tests covering:
  - PASS verdict with no findings
  - BLOCK with structure finding (special case)
  - Correct counting of answered checks
  - Warnings being ignored in counts
  - Proper ordering of blocked check IDs
  - Single and all block scenarios
  - Both agent and validator source findings

### Verification
✅ Build succeeds: `pnpm --filter frai-gate build`  
✅ All 20 tests pass: `pnpm --filter frai-gate test`  
✅ Manual testing confirms:
- `--summary` works correctly and outputs the expected format
- Default text output still functions properly
- `--json` takes priority over `--summary`
- Help text is correctly updated
